title: Cross-Platform Data Freshness SLA Rollup
dataSources: dbt test results (`dbt:run_results`), warehouse metadata (`snowflake:query_history`, `bigquery:jobs`), and pipeline event logs.
app: dbt test results (`run_results.json`) and cross-platform freshness signals from warehouse INFORMATION_SCHEMA via DB Connect and HEC.
spl:
index=bi (sourcetype=dbt:run_results OR sourcetype=montecarlo:incident OR sourcetype=soda:scan)
| eval signal=case(sourcetype="dbt:run_results","dbt",sourcetype="montecarlo:incident","monte_carlo",sourcetype="soda:scan","soda")
| stats count as events, sum(eval(match(status,"(?i)fail|breach|new"))) as breaches by dataset, signal
| eval breach_rate=round(100*breaches/events,1)
| where breaches>0
| sort - breach_rate
description: Unifies freshness/quality breach signals from dbt, Monte Carlo and Soda into a single per-dataset SLA rollup so leaders see one reliability number per table regardless of tool.
value: Data teams run several observability tools; a cross-tool rollup gives a single source of truth for which datasets are unreliable, cutting through per-vendor dashboards.
implementation: Normalise dataset names across sources with a lookup; schedule daily and publish the rollup to a reliability scorecard.
visualization: Table of dataset by cross-tool breach rate, reliability scorecard.
grandmaExplanation: We combine the alerts from all your data-quality tools into one score per table so everyone agrees on which data to trust.
